description: R31-JOURNEY feature registry (ADR-TEST-01): every user-facing harness capability x every path a run can take x the account shapes people have. A cell is feature x path x shape for a shape the path admits. Each feasible cell is covered by a real-stack test on the scripted model (the journey runner's plan, or a test listed in `tests`), or tracked as a gap naming its follow-up; a rule marks a cell impossible or out of scope with its reason. scripts/journey_matrix.py --check holds it to the tree; backend/python/tests/cohesion/test_c38_journey_registry.py fails when the code grows a tool source, executor kind, run kind, surface, via or engine the registry does not name.

features.label: MCP server whose tools the agent names
MCP server held whole, listed at the run's first use (D-LAZY-2)
A read from a server held whole that nothing describes and nothing is stored of, found by a capability search or by loading its toolset, never by knowledge alone (R36LIVE-FU-2, R43MCP-FU-4)
A job inherits its parent's first-use MCP pins: no second listing, the pinned tools and nothing outside them, the approval rules kept (R31-HOT2)
MCP server signed in with OAuth, the person's own credential and its refresh
MCP hub: admin-approved manifests, STDIO runners, server kinds
Connector toolset (Jira-shaped)
Skills the run is offered and mounted (pinned skills)
A skill loaded on demand by its tool
Knowledge base search and fetch
Web search and fetch
A public code repository the job clones after the person allows it (ph git clone; on by default where web access is on, ADR-REPO-01)
A clone the person declines: nothing is fetched and the answer says plainly it could not read the code (ADR-RUN-03 D5)
Files attached to a chat turn
Files, workspace and artifacts a run makes
A call is held and a card asks
Allow runs the held call exactly once
Deny or Block refuses it and nothing is sent
An org admin's rule decides (tool rule, class rule)
The flow guard holds an external write after a private read
The run asks the person back and goes on with the answer
Not-found and grounded-confidence answer contract (ADR-RUN-03)
A budget cut ends the run with its partial work kept
The person cancels a running turn
The person deletes the conversation; its run stops (ADR-RUN-05)
Governed memories proposed, kept and recalled
A person's or org's data erased, never coming back
An agent loop run's own code sandbox and run_code, decided at admission and pinned at its claim (P5.11, ADR-CAP-01)

A sandbox's memory limit ends the code's work and the person is told: on an engine job, on gVisor the whole sandbox, the run fails out_of_memory once with the limit named; on runc the command is killed and the engine goes on (R31GVISO-FU-3); on a loop run or a /run, run_code's result names the limit and the run goes on (R33-JGAPS)

A message sent while the run works joins it: read when the run goes on, a file it may not read named in the answer; where the surface cannot show the run's card, the reply says it still waits (R35SLACK-FU-1/3, D-SLACK-ASK 5)

A person's decline, with its reason, holds for the same call in the conversation: asked again by their job's parent or their next turn, it is declined and nobody is asked twice (ADR-GRANT-01 D9, R36LIVE-FU-1)

A conversation decision is one person's: in a shared conversation a collaborator's "Allow for this conversation" never answers the owner's ask, and only the run's own person may give one (ADR-GRANT-01 D9, SEC-B-01, SEC-C-04)
An allowed website after a private read: a sandbox request that could carry the data waits on the site card, a registry install still works (SEC-A-01/02, ADR-SEC-03)
A job's ask answered after the gateway's hold never stops its work: it keeps working, the decision reaches the running turn, and the approved call runs and is used there (ADR-RUN-06, R39-RESEARCH)
A request that names a public repository hands the job its clone command: the job clones it after the person allows it and reads its code (R41-CLONE)
A repository the request names that the job never cloned is said in the answer's could-not-do line, from the journal (R41-CLONE, ADR-RUN-03 D5)
A multi-step turn shows its plan: journaled as task.*, drawn as the chat's checklist, its tool call never a step (R49-PLAN, ADR-OWD-07 D-PLAN-1)
A memory kept for one conversation: kept when the run ends, given to that conversation's next turn and to no other (R49-PLAN, ADR-MEM-01 D7)

codeKeys.description: The code's own enumerations, each mapped to what of the registry stands for it: a feature, a path, or an explicit reason it is none. The cohesion test reads the code and fails on a key missing here.

workflow_code.none: A workflow's code step (ADR-WF-01) runs no model and offers the person no tool; its runs are a schedule's, scheduled.cron stands for them

authoring.none: The agent builder's authoring run writes a draft agent, not a conversation; it is the builder's (journey-agent-build-try.spec.ts), not a run path a feature rides

service.none: A service principal is an account shape (service), not a path: it rides agent.quick and the scheduled paths

repository_push.none: GIT-FLOW's push of the run's session branch to the person's connected repository: a write the person confirms, covered by the GITF lane tests (test_gitf_repository_fetch_docker.py), not a journey feature

pipeshub.policy_check.none: The managed hook's question to the run's policy about the engine's own edits and commands (G-25): it adds no capability; approval.block and sandbox.code cover the rules it applies

rules.reason: Only a code_task job inherits a parent's first-use pins (R31-HOT2): a top-level run pins at its own first use, and a deep sub-agent's parent (a saved agent) names its tools (X-WHOLE-SEEDED)
A saved agent's job is granted named tools, which Node pins at admission; there is no first-use pin to carry (X-WHOLE-SEEDED)

Today's loop pins nothing: no at-first-use listing, no mounted skills, no harness budget, no governed memory; it cannot hold a call for a person (a write that needs approval is refused approval_unavailable, oracle of e2e_covering_array.py) and has no ask-back
The default chat holds each of the person's servers whole (the assistant definition, backend/python/app/api/routes/agent.py, atFirstUse); a server named tool by tool is a saved agent's

A saved agent's server grant names its tools (run-spec.ts grantedTools: only a definition with atFirstUse holds a server whole, and only the assistant's has it); its named servers are still listed at first use, which mcp.named on the same paths runs
The owner's default chat runs Agent mode on the harness (ASSIST1); a classic default chat is the seeded shape's legacy switch (CTL-7), which classic/seeded covers

A scheduled run is unattended: it is granted no memory write scope (P7.3), its turn carries no chat files, and nobody is in the chat to stop it or delete it (an operator's cancel is surface ops, OPS-01)

A resume continues the pinned run: these act at admission or apart from the run, and their cell on the path the run started on holds them; what a resume must keep (the MCP pins, the decision, the answer, its files, its budget, its cancel) stays in
They act on the parent's conversation: the parent's cell (agent.deep) holds them; a child is stopped and erased with its parent
A /run command is one run_code call with no model (SLASH3, runKind command): it offers no tool, asks nothing and answers nothing

Erasure acts on what a person or org stored, not on a run: the data a path leaves is the same kind per executor (conversations, journal, workspaces, sandboxes, memories), so classic, assistant.agent, agent.quick, job.opencode and scheduled.cron stand for the rest (equivalence classes, ADR-TEST-01 D4)
A service account holds no person's own servers or sign-ins, has nobody to ask back and keeps no personal memory
An external MCP client sends no files, and a call held for approval waits in the inbox (Needs you), where approval.allow on the start path holds it
The agent-code profile is a durable loop run's (sandboxProfileFor: executor loop only); an engine job runs in its own engine sandbox and today's loop pins nothing at admission

repository_fetch is served only by an engine job's Tool Gateway (ph git clone, WP-63 part A): a loop run reads code through a connected repository or a web fetch. The default chat and a saved agent reach it through the job they hand the work to, the job.* cells on the owner, owner_pinned and seeded shapes

The assistant's search modes offer no run_code (their tool set is the mode's: knowledge or web search, artifacts, skills, the person's question); code runs in Agent mode, whose assistant.agent cells hold it

The assistant's search modes are knowledge-only or web-only by design (R50JFIX-5): Node grants internal_search the organization's knowledge and no tool, web_search the web search tool and no knowledge, never an MCP server or a toolset (run-spec.ts assistantGrant; a run with no agent definition pins no skill), and the worker's mode policy loads only those (app/agents/chat_modes/policy.py, app/harness/assembly/chat.py build_chat_environment). So no server is held for a first use, a capability search, a hub runner or an OAuth sign-in, nothing is pinned to preload, and nothing the mode calls writes outside or sends, which is what a card, an org rule, the flow guard and a decline ask about. Agent mode's assistant.agent cells hold every one of them; skills load on demand and memory are run on the mode

ADR-RUN-03: the grounding check (the not-found note, the question before a job, the evidence-capped confidence) runs where a turn hands work to a coding engine or may; a loop run with no engine authority answers under the contract's prompt alone, as classic chat does, so there is no not-found note or capped confidence to observe. The default chat's cells (assistant.agent, smoke and AC-E) and every job.* cell hold the check
The seeded agent's Slack bot runs the loop agent, which has no engine authority (X-CONTRACT-LOOP)

The default assistant's Slack bot answers a lookup on its loop (R50JFIX-11): on the lane its run handed nothing to a job (no child; the thread got the loop's own reply), and ADR-RUN-03's grounding check runs only before a hand-off (app/harness/assembly/grounding_gate.py, loop.py _ground), so a loop answer has no not-found note or capped confidence to observe (X-CONTRACT-LOOP). Whether that Slack run should be offered code_task is R50JFIX-FU-1

A sub-agent cannot ask the person (TAG_UI_ONLY, harness_core/tools/tags.py; ADR-RUN-03 may_ask): its need goes up as an [ESCALATION] that the deep coordinator asks (ADR-RUN-04 D1 amended by R36-COVER), the agent.deep cell

Nobody is in a scheduled run's chat to write to it, a /run runs no model to read a message, and today's loop takes no message while it runs (steeringRefusal not_durable): the web app waits for its answer

No second person can act in the conversation: a saved agent's conversation is shared read-only (es_validators agentConversationShareParamsSchema) and a deep sub-agent is its child; a scheduled run and /run have one person; today's loop holds no call for anyone (X-CLASSIC)
Nothing is declined to carry: today's loop holds no call for a person (X-CLASSIC) and /run makes no tool call (X-COMMAND)

Allowed websites reach only an engine job's sandbox (RunSites is built for engine runs; a loop run's code sandbox has no website egress), so the flow hold has nothing to hold there; the assistant's search modes run no code at all (X-CHAT-MODE-CODE)

Only an engine job's Tool Gateway holds a call and answers it deferred past the hold (ADR-RUN-06): a loop run suspends on its ask, and the default chat and a saved agent reach the rule through the job they hand the work to, the job.* cells

A saved agent, its deep sub-agent, a schedule, the MCP surface and /run name each server's tools from the attachment (X-WHOLE-SEEDED); only the default chat holds a server whole, the case where nothing names its tools before its first use

A saved agent names each server's tools from its attachment (X-WHOLE-SEEDED), so nothing is found by capability on its runs: its coder agent's jobs, its resumed and recovered runs (they start on agent.quick) and its Slack bot; the person's own undescribed server is not the agent's to use

The plan tool is offered to root loop turns only (ADR-OWD-07 D-PLAN-1): today's loop journals no task.*, the assistant's search modes answer from one source and are never offered it, a deep child is planned by its parent's create_plan, and a /run runs no model

gate.rule: every feasible feature x path the runner implements once, on the path's primary shape, plus every must-run cell

fullOnly.why: These reach an ACP job through the Tool Gateway or the job's sandbox controller, the same code for every engine; the gate runs each on the native engines, and on every ACP engine the turns its ACP mapper words differently (files and commands, cards, the budget cut, cancel, a clone); the capability search and a message joining a running job (R47-JOURNEY) are the gateway's and the parent's, the same for every engine
The same gateway and sandbox paths the gate runs on the owner's Codex job and on opencode; Claude Code's own mapper runs in its use, deny, allow, budget, cancel and repository journeys
A signed webhook changes only how the firing starts, which the gate's webhook use journey proves; the scheduled run's features run on scheduled.cron in the gate

Each kills the worker and the query service and runs alone (about 75 s); the gate's recovery allow journey proves the property that matters most, an approved write done exactly once by the new attempt; the run's own budget, code and memory turns on a recovered run run in the full tier too
A memory journey runs alone; the gate keeps it on the default chat and the owner's Codex job, where the owner keeps memories

A hub journey runs alone (it makes the servers and ends every owner's token); the credential and runner path is the query service's and the worker's Tool Gateway's, the same for every executor (MCP-E2E's finding), so the gate runs it on the default chat, a saved agent, deep mode, the opencode job and Slack

Node declines the repeated call the same way for every engine's parent and every loop's next turn (ConversationGrantReach); the gate runs it on the owner's Codex job, the break MR-9 records, and on the default chat's next turn

full.rule: every feasible cell the runner implements, every shape of every path (exhaustive: paths x shapes is small)
